architecture.mechanism: Statistical process control to monitor emitter flow and implement corrective procedures when process falls out of control
architecture.intervention: Implement regular monitoring of emitter flow rates within the first 7 working hours of operation and implement corrective procedures when flow rates deviate from statistical control limits
architecture.expected_effect: Early detection of clogging issues before significant flow reduction occurs, allowing intervention before discharge falls below rated specifications
architecture.falsification_test: Compare flow rates in laterals with and without implementing statistical process control monitoring - measure percentage of emitters maintaining design flow after one season
